tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session navigated to the Magento Admin Transactions grid, closed a notification, filled the grid filter inputs (Order ID, Transaction ID, Transaction Type, Is Closed, Created At from/to), clicked Search, and observed the grid result state. Stable element hashes were captured for each interacted element.

Task Definition:
- Build a reusable, deterministic automation tool that navigates to the admin transactions page (assumes an existing authenticated admin session), sets filter criteria provided by the caller, clicks Search to apply filters, and returns the filtered results.

Action Plan (to-do list of necessary tool steps):
1) Navigate to the Transactions page URL derived from {base_url}.
2) Close any blocking admin notification overlay using the recorded close link selector.
3) Populate the filter inputs: Order ID, Transaction ID.
4) Set dropdowns: Transaction Type and Is Closed using visible option text.
5) Populate optional Created At date range start and end.
6) Click the Search / Apply Filters button.
7) Wait briefly for page to reload/submit.
8) Extract the resulting grid content or 'No records found' message and return as output.

Variable Identification (input parameters):
- base_url (required): root URL where the admin is hosted.
- order_id (optional): text to enter in Order ID filter.
- txn_id (optional): text to enter in Transaction ID filter.
- txn_type (optional): visible Transaction Type option label to select (Order, Authorization, Capture, Void, Refund).
- is_closed (optional): visible Is Closed option label to select (All, Yes, No).
- created_at_from (optional): start date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for Created At filter.
- created_at_to (optional): end date string (YYYY-MM-DD) for Created At filter.

Step Optimization:
- Use recorded deterministic elementHash values for each interaction to maximize selector stability (these hashes reference the exact elements the agent interacted with during recording).
- Provide robust CSS/XPath fallbacks (header-anchored XPaths and common name attributes) when the elementHash cannot be resolved in a new environment.
- Avoid conditional branching: optional inputs are accepted but steps deterministically write the provided values (empty strings clear fields). This keeps execution linear while allowing optional filters.
- Skip login/authentication steps: per guidance the tool assumes an authenticated admin session; do not include authentication in this tool to match the recorded session.
- Replace multi-click UI discovery with direct elementHash clicks where available (e.g., close popup and Search button) to avoid flaky locator resolution.

Selectors and reliability notes:
- Prefer id/name selectors (e.g., input[name='txn_id'], select[name='txn_type'], input[name='created_at[from]']) if the runtime DOM exposes them.
- When id/name are not available, use header-anchored XPath selectors that target the grid's thead/tr[@class='filter']/td[position()]. These are robust for Magento admin grids when header text remains unchanged.
- Ensure the environment has JavaScript enabled for datepickers/ajax grids when required. The recorded session ran with JS disabled but used plain inputs; the tool is compatible with both states by writing directly into the inputs.

Security/failure mitigation:
- The tool does not perform login; ensure the calling context provides an authenticated browser session.
- If a selector resolves to multiple elements in a different admin theme, prefer adjusting to a name/id-based selector; the tool provides fallbacks. If elementHash is stale, the CSS/XPath fallbacks are used.

This tool is single-purpose: apply filters on the Magento Admin Transactions grid and return the results. Version: 2026-02-01-v2
name: magento_admin_transactions_search_tool_v2
description: Automates searching the Magento Admin Transactions grid using the recorded, deterministic selectors. Navigates to the Transactions page, closes the admin notification, fills filter inputs (Order ID, Transaction ID, Transaction Type, Is Closed, Created At range) and clicks Search, then extracts the resulting grid contents.

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento Admin Transactions grid page.
Close the admin notification popup (deterministic selector recorded from the session). If the popup is not present this click will target nothing but is safe.
Set the Order ID filter input. Uses the recorded deterministic element hash; falls back to header-positioned selector if necessary.
Set the Transaction ID filter input. Uses the recorded deterministic element hash; falls back to name or header-positioned selector.
Select the Transaction Type option by visible text (e.g. 'Capture'). If {txn_type} is empty the select will not change (empty string selects nothing).
Select the Is Closed option by visible text ('All', 'Yes', 'No'). If {is_closed} is empty the select will not change.
Set Created At 'From' date (YYYY-MM-DD). Uses recorded element hash or common name-based selector as fallback; input an empty string to leave blank.
Set Created At 'To' date (YYYY-MM-DD). Uses recorded element hash or header-positioned fallback.
Click the Search / Apply Filters button (recorded element hash points to the Search button).
Wait briefly for the page to update after applying filters (server-side render / form submit).
Capture the grid results after the filter is applied. Returns structured rows when present or the 'No records found' indicator.
steps.goal: Extract resulting Transactions grid rows (all visible columns) and any 'No records found' message.

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Base URL of the Magento site (e.g. 'http://dockerized-magento.local'). The tool will navigate to '{base_url}/index.php/admin/sales_transactions/'. Must be an admin session (already authenticated).

input_schema.name: order_id
input_schema.description: Order ID or increment id to filter by (text). If empty the field will be left blank.

input_schema.name: txn_id
input_schema.description: Transaction ID to filter by (text). If empty the field will be left blank.

input_schema.name: txn_type
input_schema.description: Visible label of the Transaction Type option to select in the filter. Use exact visible text (e.g. 'Capture'). Leave empty to not change the control.

input_schema.name: is_closed
input_schema.description: Visible label for the Is Closed dropdown. Use 'All' to select the empty/all state, or 'Yes'/'No'.

input_schema.name: created_at_from
input_schema.description: Start date for Created At filter in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to not set.

input_schema.name: created_at_to
input_schema.description: End date for Created At filter in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty to not set.
